data.narrative:
Neuromeka is a public robotics and manufacturing company listed on KOSDAQ (ticker 277810.KQ) that has raised $36.5M to date. The target operates within a fragmented sector comprising one public comparable and eight private peers, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The robotics and manufacturing sector contains ten same-sector peers overall, but none satisfy the minimum threshold of three comparables within narrowly defined filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier. A broad all-sector median approach would introduce excessive selection bias and is therefore rejected.

Without sufficient narrow peer data to support triangulation, this analysis cannot derive a defensible valuation range using market multiples. The primary uncertainties are the fragmentation of the robotics manufacturing sector, the scarcity of public trading comparables, and the heterogeneity of private fundraising rounds. Future valuation work should either: (1) expand the peer set to adjacent sectors with methodological transparency; (2) employ DCF or cost-build-up methods if detailed unit economics are available; or (3) monitor the company's public market trading activity for observed multiples post-listing. Current data does not support a quantitative synthesis.
